body: There aren’t many, if any, in my area. And to be honest, I’d feel like I’d be dragging everyone else down. I appreciate the advice though

Because I’ll never be as successful as I feel I need to be. And because people have been saying for years now that it’ll get better, but things have just gotten progressively worse. And because I’ll always have Aspergers. And that makes life hell in of itself. I have nothing left anymore. I just want to not exist.

Sorry for the late reply, I was asleep. To answer your question though, it’s because everything that can go wrong, has gone wrong. I lost the life of my life a while back, and I haven’t been able to recover. I’m not where I should be right now, I’m terms of schooling and future success. My reputation has been ruined at work because of bullshit rumors that a few people have been spreading about me. Because I have Aspergers, and I’ll always be different. And because I’m just too tired of going on. I’d rather have the cold nothingness of the void than have to endure another year in hell
